title: CheckpointHeader
description: Header record for a compacted checkpoint file (cap-001, FR-03). Stored as first line of <v>.checkpoint.ndjson.

checkpoint_version.description: Version number of the last commit included in this checkpoint.

created_at_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC) when checkpoint was written.

commit_count.description: Number of ManifestCommit records in this checkpoint (excluding header).
